Interface QueryExecutionInfo

All Known Implementing Classes:
MockQueryExecutionInfo
public interface QueryExecutionInfo
Holds information about a query execution.
Author:
Tadaya Tsuyukubo

  • Method Details

    • getMethod

      Method getMethod()
      Returns the method used for the query execution.
      Returns:
      invoked method

    • getMethodArgs

      @Nullable Object[] getMethodArgs()
      Returns the arguments passed to the invocation. This value may be null when the method is invoked without any arguments.
      Returns:
      argument lists or null if the invoked method did not take any arguments

    • getThrowable

      @Nullable Throwable getThrowable()
      Returns the exception thrown by the invocation. For the ProxyExecutionListener.beforeQuery(QueryExecutionInfo) callback, or when the query execution did not throw any error, this returns null.
      Returns:
      thrown exception

    • getConnectionInfo

      ConnectionInfo getConnectionInfo()
      Returns the associated ConnectionInfo.
      Returns:
      connection info

    • isSuccess

      boolean isSuccess()
      Returns whether the query execution was successful. This value is populated only after the query execution completes. A query execution is considered successful when the Publisher returned from Statement.execute() either received completion or at least one element is emitted regardless of it has received cancellation.
      Returns:
      true when query has successfully executed

    • getBatchSize

      int getBatchSize()
      Returns the size of the batch query. In other words, this is the number of calls to Batch.add(String).
      Returns:
      batch size

    • getQueries

      List<QueryInfo> getQueries()
      Returns the list of QueryInfo.
      Returns:
      the list of queries; never null

    • getType

      ExecutionType getType()
      Returns the type of query execution.
      Returns:
      type of query execution

    • getBindingsSize

      int getBindingsSize()
      Returns the number of bindings. In other words, this is the number of calls to Statement.add().
      Returns:
      size of the binding

    • getExecuteDuration

      Duration getExecuteDuration()
      Returns the time spent executing the query.

      Duration is only populated in appropriate phase. (e.g.: ProxyExecutionListener.afterQuery(QueryExecutionInfo))

      Returns:
      query execution duration

    • getThreadName

      String getThreadName()
      Returns the name of the thread executing the query.
      Returns:
      thread name

    • getThreadId

      long getThreadId()
      Returns the ID of the thread executing the query.
      Returns:
      thread ID

    • getProxyEventType

      ProxyEventType getProxyEventType()
      Returns the proxy event type for the query execution.
      Returns:
      proxy event type; one of ProxyEventType.BEFORE_QUERY, ProxyEventType.AFTER_QUERY, or ProxyEventType.EACH_QUERY_RESULT

    • getCurrentResultCount

      int getCurrentResultCount()
      Represents the Nth Result. For each query-result callback (ProxyExecutionListener.eachQueryResult(QueryExecutionInfo)), this value indicates the Nth Result, starting from 1 (first, second, third, and so on). This returns 0 before query execution (ProxyExecutionListener.beforeQuery(QueryExecutionInfo)). For after-query execution (ProxyExecutionListener.afterQuery(QueryExecutionInfo)), it returns the total number of Result objects returned by this query execution.
      Returns:
      Nth number of query result

    • getCurrentMappedResult

      @Nullable Object getCurrentMappedResult()
      The mapped query result available for each query-result callback (ProxyExecutionListener.eachQueryResult(QueryExecutionInfo)). For the before- and after-query execution callbacks (ProxyExecutionListener.beforeQuery(QueryExecutionInfo) and ProxyExecutionListener.afterQuery(QueryExecutionInfo)), this returns null.
      Returns:
      currently mapped result

    • getValueStore

      ValueStore getValueStore()
      Returns the ValueStore associated with the scope of the before/after query execution. Mainly used for passing values between ProxyExecutionListener.beforeQuery(QueryExecutionInfo) and ProxyExecutionListener.afterQuery(QueryExecutionInfo).
      Returns:
      value store
